statements.statement: The procedure code billed was CPT 93226
The diagnosis codes listed were I49.5 and I47.1
The denial reason code was PR-204
The patient presented with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent dizziness
There was concern for underlying arrhythmia
The patient had a history suggestive of sick sinus syndrome and supraventricular tachycardia
The Holter monitor was ordered to correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances
The claim was denied as not medically necessary
The denial was based on medical policy requiring specific diagnostic criteria
The provided records did not demonstrate that less intensive diagnostic alternatives were exhausted
The patient's condition did not warrant this specific level of scrutiny at the time of service
